تقتطعن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِعْنَ (taqtaṭiʕna) /taq.ta.tˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# تُقْتَطَعْنَ (tuqtaṭaʕna) /tuq.ta.tˤaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
